## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:cli` · `area:api`, into `pm:queue` (`finding` removed). `createHonoApp`'s catch arms render a declared ADR-0112 `status`/`code`, as #16545 made the direct-mount adapter do

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-14T02:57Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Re-checked on `origin/main`:** both catch arms in `packages/adapters/hono/src/index.ts` answer `errorJson(c, err.message || 'Internal Server Error', err.statusCode || 500)` (`:744`, `:794`). They read `statusCode` only, so a declared `status`/`code` is lost.
- **Why p2:** a missing record answers `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` instead of `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` (#5138's contract) on every `createHonoApp` host. An outage brand (`AuthzStoreUnavailableError`, `503`) also collapses to `500`, which hides #23245's fix (PR #23363) on these hosts.
- **Lane:** `packages/adapters/hono` is `domain:cli`. `Clause-②: no`: the adapter renders what the contract already declares.
- **Direction: the card's "What done looks like", as written.**
  - Reuse #16545's recognition. ⛔ No second recogniser.
  - An escaped throw that is not a declared envelope keeps answering `500`, with no cause in the body.
  - **Pins on the wire:** a missing record gives `404`; `AuthzStoreUnavailableError` gives `503`; a bare `Error` gives `500`.
  - **Neighbour:** #23214 touches the same catch-all. Read its state at claim.

Claim: PM loop round 7, serial (#23365: `createHonoApp`'s two catch arms render an escaped throw that carries a declared ADR-0112 `status` and a registered `code` as that envelope, through #16545's recogniser; a bare throw stays `500`) · 2026-10-14T17:51Z
Session: `session_01Q9PZ5Pzqcus4woVvTZwWNU`
Account: `sunhaolin` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee from this act)
Branch: `claude/issue-23365-hono-declared-envelope`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-23365`

Seat: `domain:cli#2` (seat post #22648)
Scope: the maintainer's 「当前任务处理完，后续改为串行派发」, the one serial claim. This seat's previous claim, #23347 (readings), was released to triage with `pm:retriage` (`6174333277`, then the Release on that card). #23365 is next in the lane's order; the `target:v18` p2 cards are still behind PR #23452.
File surface (read on `origin/main` `869a381dc9`; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/adapters/hono/src/index.ts`, ONLY `createHonoApp`'s two catch arms. Both read `errorJson(c, err.message || 'Internal Server Error', err.statusCode || 500)`: `:782` (the auth fallback) and `:831` (the `dispatch()` catch-all).
- `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts` and its entry `src/index.ts`, ONLY if reusing `declaredEnvelopeForThrow` (`adapter.ts:284`, module-private today) needs it exported. In that case:
  - the PR declares the added export `Clause-②: yes`;
  - this seat re-grades the claim, and a `TIER_DEFAULT` seat record is owed.
  - ⛔ No second recogniser.
- One new pin file, `packages/qa/http-conformance/src/hono-*.conformance.test.ts`. `@objectstack/hono`'s own tests alias the runtime to a stub, so the wire pins live where the real pair is composed. Plus one `.changeset/23365-*.md`.
- ⛔ Not `packages/runtime`, not `packages/core`, not `packages/spec`, not the direct-mount adapter's own behaviour.

Container & model: `S`, judged (two catch arms and one reuse; the recogniser exists), `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: "no path-derived mandate"). Ceiling as graded: `Clause-②: no` (the adapter renders what the contract already declares, triage `6159864250`), no contract face, so CI plus this seat's read. If an export is added, `TIER_DEFAULT` (the declaration face).
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `createHonoApp's two catch arms in packages/adapters/hono (this lane) | plugin-hono-server's #16545 recogniser, reused, at most exported | every createHonoApp host whose dispatch() throws a declared envelope (a missing record's 404, an outage's 503, the /data version refusals' 409 and 400)`
Thread-read: 6159864250
Serial constraints cleared:
- #23214, triage's named neighbour on the same catch-all, landed as `cb9841aa25` (PR #23466). Its arity work does not touch the catch arms.
- No open PR touches `packages/adapters/hono/src/index.ts` or `plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts` (open PRs read at 2026-10-14T17:50Z). The Version Packages PR touches only `packages/adapters/hono/CHANGELOG.md` and `package.json`.
- No `pm:dispatched` claim names `adapters/hono`.
- This seat has no other card in flight.
